root_cause: The Tab key press on the departure date input is being prevented by a listener, likely added by Vanilla Calendar Pro when inputMode is true. This prevents focus from moving to the next field.
repair_strategy: Set the inputMode option to false in the VCP calendar options to prevent VCP from adding a keydown listener that blocks Tab navigation, while preserving datepicker functionality.
expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key will move focus from the departure date field to the passengers field as expected in a standard form.
functional_risks: Vanilla Calendar Pro may alter keyboard behavior inside the calendar popup when inputMode is false
Datepicker may not respond to certain keyboard inputs as expected
Inline datepickers may be unaffected since inputMode was already false for inline mode
verification_requirements: Pressing Tab on the departure date field moves focus to the passengers field
Clicking the departure date field still opens the datepicker calendar
Selecting a date in the calendar updates the input and closes the calendar
Pressing Escape closes the calendar and returns focus to the departure date field
Tab navigation works correctly when the calendar is closed
